thag5.10:1.1: Upārambhacitto dummedho suṇāti jinasāsanaṃ: ārakā hoti saddhammā nabhaso pathavī yathā. || ||
thag5.10:2.1: upārambhacitto dummedho suṇāti jinasāsanaṃ: parihāyati saddhammā kāḷapakkhe va candimā. || ||
thag5.10:3.1: upārambhacitto dummedho suṇāti jinasāsanaṃ: parisussati saddhamme maccho appodake yathā. || ||
thag5.10:4.1: upārambhacitto dummedho suṇāti jinasāsanaṃ: na virūhati saddhamme khette bījaṃ va pūtikaṃ. || ||
thag5.10:5.1: yo ca tuṭṭhena cittena suṇāti jinasāsanaṃ khepetvā āsave sabbe sacchikatvā akuppataṃ, pappuyya paramaṃ santiṃ parinibbāti anāsavo 'ti. || || Yasadatto thero.
